reasoning: Both attempts fix every rubric item correctly and pass all checks, with nearly the same HUD changes. They differ only in PlacedBlocks.luau. A keeps the store's structure and makes targeted immutable updates, wrapped in Charm.batch. B replaces the lastPlaced signal with a computed value. That is valid and arguably cleaner, but it goes past the minimal fix the task asked for. A wins narrowly for staying closest to the original design.

criteria.note: onBlockPlaced now uses setHistory(function(history) ... table.clone(history) ... end), which stores a new table, and leaves the frozen flag alone.
clear now calls setHistory({}) and setLastPlaced(nil) inside Charm.batch.
Adds lastPlaced = VideCharm.useSignalState(PlacedBlocks.getLastPlaced) and binds Text to lastPlaced().
Wraps Charm.subscribe in Vide.cleanup(...), so the subscription is disposed when show destroys the HUD's scope.

The store keeps its shape and API. It now clicks when the count goes up instead of when lastPlaced changes, so placing the same type twice clicks; this is reasonable and the comment explains it, but it is a small behavior change.
luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua all pass.
onBlockPlaced clones the history table, inserts into the copy, and sets the copy.
Bridges getLastPlaced through useSignalState and binds the label to lastPlaced().
cleanup(Charm.subscribe(...)) ties the subscription to the HUD's scope.

Removes the lastPlaced signal and makes getLastPlaced a computed of history[#history]. Callers still get a working getter, but this restructures the store beyond what the task needed, and it has the same count-based click change as A.
luau-lsp, selene, and StyLua all pass.

strengths: Fixes all three reported bugs and the clear bug at their causes
Small, targeted changes to the store
Charm.batch makes the two signal updates land together
weaknesses: The click trigger moved from lastPlaced to the count, a small change in behavior (arguably a fix)

strengths: Deriving lastPlaced from history leaves one source of truth, so the two can't drift apart
weaknesses: Restructures the store's internals more than the task required
Same small change to when the click plays as A
